P1.title: ScholarMaster: A Layered Edge-Native Architecture for Real-Time Context-Aware Intelligent Systems
P1.research_question: How can an edge-native cyber-physical system coordinate multi-stage AI perception pipelines in real time while enforcing non-negotiable privacy boundaries without cloud offloading?
P1.hypothesis: An 8-layer decoupled Onion macro architecture with zero-copy UMA memory layout can sustain sub-30ms multi-modal inference while confining raw data to volatile RAM.
P1.success_criterion: Sub-33ms frame processing latency and zero uncontained raw frame persistence.

P2.title: A Context-Aware Multi-Modal Framework for Asymmetric Risk Control in Student Engagement Analysis
P2.research_question: How can multi-modal edge systems balance false-positive and false-negative errors in student engagement sensing under high uncertainty?
P2.hypothesis: Contextual Bayesian prior conditioning combined with an asymmetric loss function reduces safety-critical false negatives without inflating false alarms.
P2.problem_scope: Multi-modal audio-visual engagement and safety decision logic.
P2.success_criterion: Statistically significant reduction in false negative rate while maintaining overall F1 > 0.88.

P3.title: Pose-Only Edge Action Sensing with Enforced Volatile Memory Confinement
P3.research_question: Can high-accuracy action and attendance monitoring be achieved on edge devices while structurally eliminating raw image retention?
P3.hypothesis: Confining raw frames to 33ms TTL volatile RAM and extracting 34-keypoint skeletal coordinates provides sufficient information for action recognition while making facial reconstruction impossible.
P3.problem_scope: Edge vision ingestion and memory privacy enforcement.
P3.success_criterion: 34-keypoint action classification accuracy comparable to raw video (>92%) with zero disk writes.

P4.title: Real-Time Schedule Compliance via Spatiotemporal Predicate Evaluation and Relational Lookup
P4.research_question: How can spatiotemporal schedule compliance be evaluated in real time over high-frequency distributed entity detections without false transitions?
P4.hypothesis: Coupling interval temporal logic with spatial debounce hysteresis (tau = 5.0s) prevents jitter-induced compliance errors in classroom monitoring.
P4.problem_scope: Spatiotemporal predicate evaluation and compliance logic.
P4.success_criterion: Sub-millisecond predicate evaluation latency with zero transient jitter errors during entity transitions.

P5.title: Memory-Bound Edge Efficiency Envelope (MBEEE): A Hardware-Level Analytical Model
P5.research_question: What is the analytical performance envelope of unified-memory edge accelerators executing concurrent vision workloads under thermal constraints?
P5.hypothesis: An extended Roofline model incorporating UMA memory contention and closed-loop 85 deg C thermal throttling accurately predicts edge pipeline throughput.
P5.problem_scope: Hardware-level analytical modeling for edge AI accelerators.
P5.success_criterion: Analytical throughput prediction error < 8% across physical Jetson Orin Nano, Xavier NX, and RPi4 platforms.

P6.title: NLOS Acoustic Sensing via Spectral Gating and GCC-PHAT
P6.research_question: Can non-semantic physics-based acoustic signal processing detect high-risk impulsive anomalies from occluded (NLOS) areas in reverberant corridors without voice recording?
P6.hypothesis: Logarithmic spectral gating combined with autocorrelation periodic rejection isolates broadband anomalies while GCC-PHAT yields accurate bearing estimation without speech recognition.
P6.problem_scope: Edge acoustic signal processing and privacy-preserving spatial monitoring.
P6.success_criterion: High anomaly detection precision (>94%) and bearing error < 12 deg under reverberant conditions (RT60 > 1.2s).

P7.title: Sub-Millisecond Identity Retrieval via HNSW + LDCC
P7.research_question: How can high-dimensional biometric vector retrieval achieve sub-millisecond latency on resource-constrained edge microprocessors for galleries exceeding 100k identities?
P7.hypothesis: Augmenting HNSW graph indexing with Local Density Compensation Clustering (LDCC) and adaptive thresholding tau(N) maintains sub-millisecond retrieval without accuracy degradation.
P7.problem_scope: High-dimensional metric indexing on edge ARM SoCs.
P7.success_criterion: Query latency < 1.0ms on ARM Cortex-A72 for 100k gallery with top-1 recall > 96.5%.

P8.title: A Cryptographic Provenance Model with Erasure-Compatible Immutability \thanks{Implementation artifacts are available upon request.
P8.research_question: How can an edge computing system maintain an immutable, tamper-evident audit log while supporting cryptographic erasure for privacy compliance (GDPR Art. 17)?
P8.hypothesis: A local ephemeral Merkle tree with Provable Information-State Key (PISK) shredding guarantees forward auditability while allowing provable data erasure upon request.
P8.problem_scope: Cryptographic provenance and erasure-compatible audit logging.
P8.success_criterion: Cryptographic proof generation < 5ms and provable non-recoverability of shredded records.

P9.title: A Hierarchical Edge Control Plane for Policy-Aware Multi-Module AI Orchestration
P9.research_question: How can an edge control plane throttle redundant multi-module neural network inferences based on physical human kinematic limits?
P9.hypothesis: Inference Rate Governance (IRG) based on entity transit velocity bounds (v <= 5.0 m/s) reduces compute cycles by >40% without missing state transitions.
P9.problem_scope: Hierarchical edge control plane and inference throttling.
P9.success_criterion: 40%+ reduction in GPU/NPU utilization with zero missed attendance or compliance events.

P10.title: Integrated Stress Validation of an Edge-Native Academic Analytics Architecture
P10.research_question: How does an integrated edge-native analytics stack behave under sustained compound environmental and cyber-physical stress over prolonged continuous execution?
P10.hypothesis: An Integrated Stress Matrix (ISM) injecting compound thermal, memory, and packet-loss faults reveals failure thresholds and validates autonomous fail-closed recovery.
P10.problem_scope: Full-stack system reliability and chaos validation.
P10.success_criterion: Zero uncontained process deadlocks and autonomous recovery under all single and dual compound fault injections.

P11.title: Lifecycle Hardening of Immutable Edge Appliances under Power and Connectivity Instability
P11.research_question: How can edge appliances recover automatically and maintain system integrity under frequent abrupt power interruptions and network outages?
P11.hypothesis: An immutable read-only rootfs combined with OverlayFS RAM storage and Blue/Green kernel rollback achieves cold-boot recovery in under 2.8 seconds with zero filesystem corruption.
P11.problem_scope: Embedded operating system hardening and lifecycle recovery.
P11.success_criterion: Reboot recovery latency <= 2.8s across 1,000 simulated hard power cuts with zero journal corruption.

P12.title: Flash Endurance Engineering for Write-Intensive Embedded Workloads: Extending SD Card Lifespan Through Kernel-Level Optimization
P12.research_question: How can flash memory endurance be maximized on write-intensive edge appliances without degrading logging and telemetry throughput?
P12.hypothesis: Kernel-level VFS write coalescing, ZRAM compression, and F2FS log-structured filesystem tuning reduce Write Amplification Factor (WAF) by >80%, extending SD card lifespan from months to years.
P12.problem_scope: Flash storage engineering and kernel VFS optimization.
P12.success_criterion: WAF reduction from >12.0 to <2.5 with zero telemetry data loss during continuous burst writes.

P13.title: Federated Drift Compensation via Active Learning in Edge Deployed Neural Networks
P13.research_question: How can edge-deployed neural networks compensate for concept drift with minimal manual labeling in privacy-constrained environments?
P13.hypothesis: Using non-semantic acoustic anomaly indicators as an active learning trigger for Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (BALD) adapts visual models with <5% of samples labeled.
P13.problem_scope: Federated active learning and concept drift adaptation.
P13.success_criterion: Model accuracy recovery >90% of fully-supervised retraining while labeling <5% of incoming samples.

P14.title: Hierarchical Federated Aggregation for Cross-Institution Model Adaptation Under Asynchronous Participation
P14.research_question: How can distributed academic institutions collaboratively train shared models under asynchronous participation and high institutional data heterogeneity?
P14.hypothesis: A hierarchical federated aggregation framework with polynomial staleness dampening converges faster and achieves higher cross-campus generalization than flat FedAvg.
P14.success_criterion: Model convergence under 50% node dropout with test accuracy parity across heterogeneous campus domains.

P15.title: Augmented Situation Awareness: Reducing Cognitive Load in Campus Security via Spatially-Anchored AR Visualization
P15.research_question: Can spatially-anchored augmented reality visualization reduce the cognitive workload and response time of campus security personnel during incident handling?
P15.hypothesis: Projecting real-time sensor alerts into the operator field of view with attention-gated filtering significantly lowers NASA-TLX cognitive load compared to 2D multi-monitor dashboards.
P15.problem_scope: Augmented reality situational awareness and human-computer interaction.
P15.success_criterion: Statistically significant (>25%) reduction in incident response time and NASA-TLX workload score.

P16.title: Beyond the Panopticon: A Longitudinal Study of Student Trust in Automated Stewardship Systems
P16.research_question: How does architectural visibility and provable privacy preservation influence student trust in automated institutional stewardship systems over extended time?
P16.hypothesis: Students exhibit significantly higher trust and lower psychological reactance when systems provide visible abstraction and proven data non-retention compared to opaque surveillance.
P16.problem_scope: Sociotechnical longitudinal trust and privacy perceptions.
P16.success_criterion: Statistically significant positive shift in trust and compliance constructs over a 16-week study period.

P17.title: Architectural Irreversibility: Enforcing Privacy, Governance, and Trust in Intelligent Campus Systems
P17.research_question: Why does policy-based privacy fail in edge cyber-physical infrastructure, and how can architectural irreversibility provide a non-negotiable ethical governance doctrine?
P17.hypothesis: Enforcing data minimization at the physical and architectural layer (capability elimination) eliminates the vulnerability of privacy guarantees to policy changes or operator error.
P17.problem_scope: Philosophy of technology, institutional ethics, and system governance.
P17.success_criterion: Establishment of a rigorous taxonomy and non-negotiable constraint framework for trustworthy campus AI.

P18.title: Runtime Enforcement of Architectural Irreversibility in Edge AI Systems \thanks{This research was conducted at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Swarnandhra College of Engineering \& Technology (Autonomous), as part of academic research activities.
P18.research_question: How can architectural irreversibility guarantees be continuously verified and enforced at runtime under adversarial fault and crash conditions?
P18.hypothesis: A FailClosedWatchdog and CircuitBreaker runtime monitor can detect invariant violations and trigger atomic volatile memory sanitization within 33ms.
P18.problem_scope: Runtime verification and fault containment in edge systems.
P18.success_criterion: 100% containment of raw data across 475 fault injection trials with fail-closed state transitions.

P19.title: Formal Threat Model and Trusted Computing Base Definition for Architecturally Irreversible Edge AI \thanks{This research was conducted at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Swarnandhra College of Engineering \& Technology (Autonomous), as part of academic research activities.
P19.research_question: What is the formal threat model and minimal Trusted Computing Base (TCB) required to guarantee information-flow non-interference in privacy-first edge AI appliances?
P19.hypothesis: Restricting the TCB to <= 2.0GB volatile RAM and formalizing A0-A5 adversary capabilities enables deductive proof of timing and data non-interference in Metric Temporal Logic.
P19.problem_scope: Formal security modeling, TCB definition, and non-interference proofs.
P19.success_criterion: Formal mathematical proofs of information-flow non-interference and bounded residual information leakage.

P20.title: The ScholarMaster Architecture: A Unified Reference Model for Privacy-First Intelligent Campus Systems
P20.research_question: How can diverse cyber-physical invariants and architectural layers across an edge AI ecosystem be formalized into a unified, extensible reference model?
P20.hypothesis: Constraint-First Architectural Synthesis (CFAS) provides a complete theorem-implementation lattice and canonical invariant namespace (INV-01..15) for privacy-first edge systems.
P20.problem_scope: Systems reference architecture and constraint synthesis.
P20.success_criterion: Complete 1-to-1 traceability between 15 canonical invariants and all executing codebase modules.

P21.title: Formal Foundations of Spatiotemporal Compliance and Distributed System Integrity
P21.research_question: What are the formal mathematical foundations governing spatiotemporal compliance verification and distributed event consistency in edge monitoring?
P21.hypothesis: An event calculus framework with Lebesgue-integrable duration bounds and vector clock lattices rigorously guarantees safety, liveness, and bounded delay.
P21.problem_scope: Formal mathematical logic and spatiotemporal proof deductions.
P21.success_criterion: Deductive proofs of 13 foundational theorems with complete lemma chains.

P22.title: Perception Integrity Foundations: Evidential Uncertainty, Disagreement Dynamics, and Blur Bounds in Edge Vision
P22.research_question: How can root optical perception integrity be formally bounded under severe environmental degradation before data enters downstream edge neural pipelines?
P22.hypothesis: Dirichlet Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) combined with analytical Laplacian blur bounds provides well-calibrated predictive uncertainty that prevents perception data cascades.
P22.problem_scope: Root perception integrity, evidential uncertainty, and optical blur bounds.
P22.success_criterion: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) <= 0.05 and zero unflagged degraded frames passed to Layer 2.

P23.title: Adaptive Trustworthy Edge Systems: Dynamic Risk-Driven Cascades and Real-Time SLA Bounds
P23.research_question: How can dynamic multi-stage edge neural cascades achieve optimal trade-offs between inferential risk and real-time SLA latency bounds under resource constraints?
P23.hypothesis: A Fenchel-Rockafellar dual optimization formulation for 4-state risk-driven cascade dispatch guarantees sub-5.0ms SLA compliance with M/G/1 queue delay bounds.
P23.problem_scope: Dynamic neural cascades, convex optimization, and real-time SLA scheduling.
P23.success_criterion: Sub-5.0ms 99th-percentile SLA compliance and optimal Pareto frontier over baseline static routing.

P24.title: Generalized Cross-Modal Recovery under Compromised Primary Sensing
P24.research_question: How can an edge multi-modal cyber-physical system maintain decision consensus when its primary sensing modality is severely degraded or blinded?
P24.hypothesis: A symmetric Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) mixture consensus model dynamically reweights sensory authority to auxiliary acoustic/thermal channels under Fisher-weighted uncertainty.
P24.problem_scope: Cross-modal sensor consensus recovery and information-theoretic fusion.
P24.success_criterion: Continuous decision integrity maintained under 100% primary optical sensor occlusion.

P25.title: ScholarMaster Macro Integration Architecture and Downstream Error Propagation Analysis
P25.research_question: How does classification error propagate across multi-stage cascaded inference pipelines, and what geometric properties govern error containment?
P25.hypothesis: Non-smooth Voronoi step jump boundaries in high-dimensional feature space bound the Error Amplification Factor (EAF), preventing exponential error explosion.
P25.problem_scope: Macro integration architecture and downstream error propagation analysis.
P25.success_criterion: Formal geometric proof of Voronoi step jump containment and empirical verification of bounded EAF <= 1.84.
